meta.title: Updating the audience of a live auction needs a remark and a live/upcoming event
gaps: Observe or click the live auction's "Update audience" control because no catalog step exposes that label or action.
Observe the "Update Audience Remarks" modal and verify OK remains disabled until a remark is entered.
Verify the "Audience Updated" toast after submitting a remark.
Repeat the behavior on an ended auction and verify the update button is disabled.
Repeat the behavior as a view-only user; another user's sign-in/session is unavailable.
Verify the control is hidden with vendor masking enabled; tenant settings cannot be changed by the catalog.
Inspect the PATCH add_audience payload because the required update action cannot be performed.
warnings: the QA memory is not built, so the plan was written without it — run `npm run rag:build`
